stuckPoints.reason: Lost the Client Secret or Webhook signing key
stuckPoints.fix: These are shown only once, at app creation. If lost, the only fix is creating a new OAuth app - editing an existing app never re-displays them.

claim.text: The Client Secret and Webhook signing key are shown only once, at creation, and can't be retrieved again when editing the app.
claim.label: tested
claim.testNote: Fetched https://developer.calendly.com/docs/authentication/creating-an-oauth-app on 2026-10-25; the required terms were present.

stuckPoints.reason: Production app rejects your redirect URI
stuckPoints.fix: Production requires an HTTPS redirect URI - the HTTP/localhost URIs allowed in Sandbox won't work once you switch to a Production app.

claim.text: For the Production environment, the redirect URI must be HTTPS; only Sandbox allows HTTP with a localhost domain.
claim.label: tested
claim.testNote: Fetched https://developer.calendly.com/docs/authentication/creating-an-oauth-app on 2026-10-25; the required terms were present.
